0.en: Mark was already moving toward the service door.
0.id: Mark sudah bergerak ke arah pintu servis.

1.en: Fifty people. Asking for you by name. That's either very good or very bad.
1.id: Lima puluh orang. Mencarimu dengan menyebut nama. Itu kalau bukan sangat bagus, ya sangat buruk.

2.en: Jack pulled the shop rag tighter around his hand.
2.id: Jack mengencangkan lap bengkel di tangannya.

4.en: I think I'll drive fast and we'll find out.
4.id: Menurutku aku nyetir cepat, nanti kita lihat sendiri.

5.en: Aiden scrambled up from the floor.

6.id: Tunggu. Kalian mau meninggalkan aku di sini?

7.en: Jack stopped at the door and looked back at him. Young, pale, muddy, and alone in a glass building at the edge of the world.
7.id: Jack berhenti di pintu dan menoleh padanya. Muda, pucat, berlumpur, dan sendirian di bangunan kaca di ujung dunia.

10.en: They'll survive an hour without you. I'm less sure about the reverse.
10.id: Mereka akan bertahan satu jam tanpamu. Kalau sebaliknya, aku kurang yakin.

11.en: Aiden thought about that for exactly one second, then grabbed his jacket.
11.id: Aiden memikirkannya tepat satu detik, lalu menyambar jaketnya.

12.en: Sarah's voice came through Jack's wrist as the vehicle pulled out.
12.id: Suara Sarah terdengar dari pergelangan Jack saat kendaraan itu melaju keluar.

13.en: I'm leaving now. Lena's staying with the cameras.
13.id: Aku berangkat sekarang. Lena tetap di kamera.

17.en: You were about to tell me to stay in the control room. I'm thirty-two weeks pregnant, Jack, not thirty-two weeks fragile. And they need to see both of us.
17.id: Kamu baru mau menyuruhku tetap di ruang kendali. Aku hamil tiga puluh dua minggu, Jack, bukan rapuh tiga puluh dua minggu. Dan mereka perlu melihat kita berdua.

18.en: Jack closed his eyes for a moment. She was right, and they both knew she was right, and that was the most annoying thing about her.
18.id: Jack memejamkan mata sejenak. Sarah benar, dan mereka berdua tahu Sarah benar, dan justru itulah hal paling menyebalkan darinya.

19.en: Okay. Meet us at the front steps.
19.id: Oke. Temui kami di tangga depan.

22.en: If you two are finished, I have something useful. The community center has a microphone in the main hall. I can route it to every public speaker in the settlement. Streets, housing blocks, medical, the utility station. Everyone hears the same thing at the same time.
22.id: Kalau kalian berdua sudah selesai, aku punya sesuatu yang berguna. Balai warga punya mikrofon di aula utama. Aku bisa menyambungkannya ke semua pengeras suara umum di permukiman. Jalan-jalan, blok hunian, bagian medis, stasiun utilitas. Semua orang mendengar hal yang sama di waktu yang sama.

25.en: One message. No rumors, no versions, no 'my neighbor said.' Whatever you say in there, the whole town hears it.
25.id: Satu pesan. Tanpa desas-desus, tanpa berbagai versi, tanpa 'kata tetanggaku.' Apa pun yang kamu katakan di sana, seluruh kota mendengarnya.

26.en: Mark glanced over from the wheel.

28.en: The streets were no longer empty.

29.en: People stood in doorways and on porches and in the middle of the road, in coats thrown over pajamas, holding children, holding each other. Every face was turned up toward the green wall of grass rising above the rooftops. Nobody was screaming. That was almost worse. They looked like people standing at the edge of a flood, waiting to find out how high the water would go.
29.id: Orang-orang berdiri di ambang pintu dan di teras dan di tengah jalan, dengan mantel disampirkan di atas piyama, menggendong anak, saling berpegangan. Setiap wajah mendongak ke dinding hijau rumput yang menjulang di atas atap-atap. Tidak ada yang menjerit. Itu nyaris lebih buruk. Mereka tampak seperti orang-orang yang berdiri di tepi banjir, menunggu untuk tahu setinggi apa air akan naik.

30.en: The community center was a low, wide building with glass doors and a flagpole out front. The crowd had spilled from its steps onto the lawn. Mark leaned on the horn once, briefly, and the people closest to the road turned, saw Jack in the passenger seat, and started talking all at once.
30.id: Balai warga adalah bangunan rendah dan lebar dengan pintu kaca dan tiang bendera di depannya. Kerumunan sudah meluber dari tangganya ke halaman rumput. Mark membunyikan klakson sekali, singkat, dan orang-orang yang paling dekat dengan jalan menoleh, melihat Jack di kursi penumpang, lalu mulai bicara bersamaan.

34.en: Jack stepped out of the vehicle into the noise.
34.id: Jack turun dari kendaraan ke tengah keriuhan itu.

35.en: Sarah was already on the steps. She came down to meet him, took one look at the rag around his hand, and raised an eyebrow.
35.id: Sarah sudah ada di tangga. Ia turun menyambutnya, melirik sekali ke lap yang membalut tangan Jack, lalu mengangkat sebelah alis.

36.en: Jack held the hand a little behind his back.
36.id: Jack menyembunyikan tangan itu sedikit di belakang punggungnya.

38.en: You keep saying that about everything.

39.en: Beside her stood a woman in her sixties with short gray hair, a medical bag over one shoulder, and the expression of someone who had been awake all night and intended to hold everyone personally responsible for it.
39.id: Di sampingnya berdiri seorang perempuan berusia enam puluhan dengan rambut kelabu pendek, tas medis tersampir di satu bahu, dan raut wajah seseorang yang sudah terjaga semalaman dan berniat meminta pertanggungjawaban pribadi dari semua orang atas hal itu.

41.en: Doctor Mercer. We've met. Mostly by phone.
41.id: Dokter Mercer. Kita sudah pernah bertemu. Kebanyakan lewat telepon.

43.en: I'm sorry about the phone calls.

44.en: She glanced at his hand, then at Sarah, then back at him.
44.id: Ia melirik tangan Jack, lalu Sarah, lalu kembali ke Jack.

45.en: Don't be. You answered them. You're bleeding. She's pregnant. You've both been up all night. After this, you're both coming to medical.
45.id: Tidak perlu. Anda menjawabnya. Anda berdarah. Dia hamil. Kalian berdua belum tidur semalaman. Setelah ini, kalian berdua ikut ke bagian medis.

50.en: You were inside a building with a machine that just did this to a town. Humor me.
50.id: Anda berada di dalam gedung bersama mesin yang barusan melakukan ini pada satu kota. Turuti saja saya.

51.en: Sarah closed her mouth. Jack had never seen anyone do that to her in one sentence before.
51.id: Sarah menutup mulutnya. Jack belum pernah melihat siapa pun membuat Sarah begitu hanya dengan satu kalimat.

52.en: Inside, the main hall was full. Rows of folding chairs had been dragged out of storage and most of them were already taken. People stood along the back wall and in the aisles. A large screen hung above a small raised stage, still showing a calendar of community events that had stopped meaning anything sometime around eleven o'clock last night.
52.id: Di dalam, aula utama penuh. Deretan kursi lipat sudah diseret keluar dari gudang dan sebagian besar sudah terisi. Orang-orang berdiri di sepanjang dinding belakang dan di lorong-lorong. Sebuah layar besar tergantung di atas panggung kecil yang ditinggikan, masih menampilkan kalender acara warga yang sudah tak berarti apa-apa sejak sekitar pukul sebelas tadi malam.

53.en: Jack climbed onto the stage. Sarah stood at his side. Mark took the doorway, and Aiden stayed close to Mark, as though Mark were the only solid thing in the room.
53.id: Jack naik ke panggung. Sarah berdiri di sisinya. Mark mengambil posisi di ambang pintu, dan Aiden tetap dekat dengan Mark, seolah Mark satu-satunya hal yang kokoh di ruangan itu.

54.en: The microphone stand was crooked. Jack straightened it. His hand left a faint smear of blood on the metal.
54.id: Tiang mikrofonnya miring. Jack meluruskannya. Tangannya meninggalkan noda darah samar di logamnya.

56.en: Her voice came quietly through his wrist.
56.id: Suaranya terdengar pelan dari pergelangan Jack.

58.en: Jack looked out at the room. Sixty faces. Behind them, through the glass doors, more people on the lawn. And beyond them, invisible, nearly five hundred people in kitchens and bedrooms and hallways, all listening to the same speakers.
58.id: Jack memandang ke seluruh ruangan. Enam puluh wajah. Di belakang mereka, di balik pintu kaca, lebih banyak orang di halaman rumput. Dan di luar itu, tak terlihat, hampir lima ratus orang di dapur dan kamar tidur dan lorong, semua mendengarkan pengeras suara yang sama.

59.en: He gripped the stand with his good hand.
59.id: Ia mencengkeram tiang mikrofon dengan tangannya yang tidak terluka.

60.en: Good morning. My name is Jack Bennett. I run the TOMBS project at the laboratory. Some of you know me. Most of you probably just know the building.
60.id: Selamat pagi. Nama saya Jack Bennett. Saya memimpin proyek TOMBS di laboratorium. Sebagian dari Anda mengenal saya. Sebagian besar mungkin hanya kenal gedungnya.

61.en: A few people nodded. Nobody smiled.
61.id: Beberapa orang mengangguk. Tak ada yang tersenyum.

62.en: Last night, around eleven o'clock, TOMBS activated without authorization. We tried to stop it, and we couldn't. When it finished, it had changed the size of everything inside the developed settlement. Every building. Every street. Every one of us.
62.id: Tadi malam, sekitar pukul sebelas, TOMBS aktif tanpa otorisasi. Kami berusaha menghentikannya, dan kami tidak bisa. Ketika selesai, mesin itu sudah mengubah ukuran segala sesuatu di dalam permukiman yang terbangun. Setiap bangunan. Setiap jalan. Setiap orang di antara kita.

64.en: Jack let that settle before he finished.

65.en: The grass outside didn't grow. We got smaller.
65.id: Rumput di luar tidak tumbuh. Kitalah yang mengecil.

66.en: The silence broke all at once. Questions came from every direction, layered over one another until none of them could be heard. Jack raised his good hand and waited. It took a long time. Sarah didn't move from his side.
66.id: Keheningan pecah seketika. Pertanyaan datang dari segala arah, saling menumpuk sampai tak satu pun bisa terdengar. Jack mengangkat tangannya yang tidak terluka dan menunggu. Lama sekali. Sarah tidak beranjak dari sisinya.

67.en: When the noise finally dropped, he kept going.
67.id: Ketika keriuhan akhirnya mereda, ia melanjutkan.

68.en: I'm going to tell you what we know, what we don't, and what we need you to do. Then I'll take questions. I promise I'll take questions.
68.id: Saya akan memberi tahu Anda apa yang kami ketahui, apa yang belum, dan apa yang perlu Anda lakukan. Setelah itu saya akan menjawab pertanyaan. Saya janji akan menjawab pertanyaan.

69.en: He gave them the instructions plainly, one at a time. Stay indoors except for essential work. Nobody goes past the end of any road, for any reason. Water is restricted starting now, and the utility station will post the limits by noon. After dark, any light that faces outward along the edge of town gets turned off. If you see an insect near your home, report it. Do not attack it.
69.id: Ia menyampaikan instruksinya dengan lugas, satu per satu. Tetap di dalam rumah kecuali untuk pekerjaan penting. Tidak ada yang melewati ujung jalan mana pun, dengan alasan apa pun. Air dibatasi mulai sekarang, dan stasiun utilitas akan mengumumkan batasannya paling lambat tengah hari. Setelah gelap, semua lampu yang menghadap keluar di sepanjang tepian kota dimatikan. Kalau melihat serangga di dekat rumah, laporkan. Jangan diserang.

70.en: A man in the third row laughed, short and disbelieving.
70.id: Seorang laki-laki di baris ketiga tertawa, pendek dan tak percaya.

71.en: Report it. To who? Pest control?

72.en: To security. Mark Jones and his officers.
72.id: Ke petugas keamanan. Mark Jones dan para petugasnya.

73.en: At the door, Mark lifted a hand.

76.en: Someone called out from the back.

78.en: Jack looked at Sarah. She stepped up to the microphone.
78.id: Jack memandang Sarah. Sarah melangkah ke mikrofon.

80.en: The calendar disappeared from the big screen. In its place, the western glass of the greenhouse, the grass beyond it, and the spider, sitting in the sun.
80.id: Kalender itu lenyap dari layar besar. Sebagai gantinya, kaca sisi barat rumah kaca, rumput di baliknya, dan laba-laba itu, mendekam di bawah matahari.

81.en: A woman near the front made a small sound and covered her mouth.
81.id: Seorang perempuan di dekat depan mengeluarkan suara kecil dan menutup mulutnya.

82.en: Lena let the footage run. The roof vents opening. The spider rising. The jump, so fast that half the room gasped after it had already happened. The boom of the landing, small and tinny through the hall speakers. Then a long, steady shot from the inside camera, looking up at the roof: a man standing perfectly still on a catwalk, and a spider the size of a car crouched on the glass a meter from his face, looking at him.
82.id: Lena membiarkan rekaman itu berjalan. Ventilasi atap terbuka. Laba-laba itu bangkit. Lompatannya, begitu cepat sampai separuh ruangan baru terkesiap setelah semuanya terjadi. Dentuman pendaratannya, kecil dan cempreng lewat pengeras suara aula. Lalu sebuah bidikan panjang dan mantap dari kamera dalam, mengarah ke atap: seorang laki-laki berdiri diam sempurna di titian, dan seekor laba-laba sebesar mobil mendekam di atas kaca satu meter dari wajahnya, menatapnya.

88.en: I stood very still and tried not to look like a fly.
88.id: Saya berdiri diam sekali dan berusaha tidak kelihatan seperti lalat.

89.en: A nervous ripple of laughter moved through the room and died away.
89.id: Tawa gugup beriak di seluruh ruangan, lalu mereda.

90.en: Sarah's voice carried over every speaker.
90.id: Suara Sarah terdengar dari setiap pengeras suara.

91.en: That's why we don't attack. Because it wasn't attacking us. It came for the insects on the glass, and it took one, and it left. We don't know yet what else is out there. Until we do, we don't start fights we can't finish.
91.id: Itu sebabnya kita tidak menyerang. Karena dia tidak sedang menyerang kita. Dia datang untuk serangga di kaca, dia mengambil satu, lalu pergi. Kita belum tahu apa lagi yang ada di luar sana. Sampai kita tahu, kita tidak memulai pertarungan yang tidak bisa kita selesaikan.

92.en: Aiden spoke up suddenly from beside Mark, louder than he probably meant to.
92.id: Aiden tiba-tiba angkat bicara dari samping Mark, lebih keras daripada yang mungkin ia maksudkan.

93.en: It looked right at him. I was there. It looked at him and it left.
93.id: Dia menatap langsung ke arahnya. Aku ada di sana. Dia menatapnya lalu pergi.

94.en: Heads turned toward him. He went red and stepped half behind Mark.
94.id: Kepala-kepala menoleh ke arahnya. Wajahnya memerah dan ia mundur setengah ke belakang Mark.

95.en: The questions came again, but slower now, one at a time.
95.id: Pertanyaan datang lagi, tapi lebih lambat sekarang, satu per satu.

97.en: Small enough that a fingernail clipping at the edge of town is longer than I am tall.
97.id: Cukup kecil sampai sepotong potongan kuku di tepi kota lebih panjang daripada tinggi badan saya.

99.en: Jack had known that one was coming since he stepped onto the stage. He still felt it land.
99.id: Jack sudah tahu pertanyaan itu akan datang sejak ia naik ke panggung. Tetap saja ia merasakannya menghantam.

100.en: I don't know. I haven't tried. And I'm not going to try until I understand exactly what it would do. If I get that wrong, I don't get a second chance, and neither do you.
100.id: Saya tidak tahu. Saya belum mencobanya. Dan saya tidak akan mencobanya sampai saya paham persis apa yang akan terjadi. Kalau saya salah, saya tidak dapat kesempatan kedua, begitu juga Anda.

101.en: Then call for help. Call the mainland.
101.id: Kalau begitu minta bantuan. Hubungi daratan utama.

102.en: We've tried. Every outside channel is silent. Satellite, radio, everything. We're still working on why.
102.id: Sudah kami coba. Semua kanal ke luar sunyi. Satelit, radio, semuanya. Kami masih mencari tahu sebabnya.

103.en: A woman stood up in the middle of the room. She kept glancing at the terminal on her wrist, as if it might ring.
103.id: Seorang perempuan berdiri di tengah ruangan. Ia terus melirik terminal di pergelangannya, seolah benda itu bisa berdering.

104.en: My daughter's in Boston. At school. She's going to call me tonight. What happens when she calls?
104.id: Anak perempuan saya di Boston. Sekolah. Nanti malam dia akan menelepon saya. Apa yang terjadi kalau dia menelepon?

105.en: Jack didn't have an answer. He made himself say so.
105.id: Jack tidak punya jawaban. Ia memaksa diri untuk mengatakannya.

106.en: I don't know that either. I'm sorry.
106.id: Itu pun saya tidak tahu. Maafkan saya.

107.en: She sat back down slowly. The man beside her put an arm around her shoulders.
107.id: Perempuan itu duduk kembali perlahan. Laki-laki di sampingnya merangkul bahunya.

108.en: Then someone near the front stood up, and the room shifted around him the way rooms do around people who are used to being listened to.
108.id: Lalu seseorang di dekat depan berdiri, dan suasana ruangan bergeser di sekelilingnya, seperti biasanya ruangan bergeser di sekitar orang yang terbiasa didengarkan.

109.en: He was broad and gray-bearded, in a canvas work jacket with grease worked permanently into the cuffs. Jack recognized him vaguely. The machine shop. Harlan, or Harland.
109.id: Ia bertubuh lebar dan berjanggut kelabu, mengenakan jaket kerja kanvas dengan oli yang sudah meresap permanen di ujung lengannya. Jack samar-samar mengenalinya. Bengkel mesin. Harlan, atau Harland.

110.en: He folded his arms and gave his name for the room's benefit rather than Jack's.
110.id: Ia bersedekap dan menyebutkan namanya demi seisi ruangan, bukan demi Jack.

111.en: Paul Harlan. I run the machine shop. I've kept half the machinery in this town running since before most of you got here. You've been very honest up there, Doctor. I'll give you that. You don't know how small, you don't know how to fix it, you don't know why the radio's dead.
111.id: Paul Harlan. Saya mengelola bengkel mesin. Saya sudah menjaga separuh mesin di kota ini tetap jalan sejak sebelum sebagian besar dari kalian datang ke sini. Anda sudah sangat jujur di atas sana, Dokter. Itu saya akui. Anda tidak tahu seberapa kecil, Anda tidak tahu cara memperbaikinya, Anda tidak tahu kenapa radionya mati.

114.en: So let me ask you something you should know. You said it activated without authorization.
114.id: Jadi biar saya tanyakan sesuatu yang seharusnya Anda tahu. Anda bilang mesin itu aktif tanpa otorisasi.

116.en: Paul nodded, as though that settled something.
116.id: Paul mengangguk, seolah hal itu sudah menjawab sesuatu.

117.en: Machines like that don't switch themselves on. Somebody switched it on.
117.id: Mesin seperti itu tidak menyala sendiri. Ada yang menyalakannya.

118.en: He let that sit for a long moment before he finished.
118.id: Ia membiarkan kata-kata itu menggantung lama sebelum menuntaskan.

120.en: The hall went silent again. Not the stunned silence from before. A sharper one. Jack could feel it pulling at every person in the room, and through Lena's speakers, at every person in every house beyond it.
120.id: Aula kembali hening. Bukan keheningan tertegun seperti sebelumnya. Yang ini lebih tajam. Jack bisa merasakannya menarik setiap orang di ruangan itu, dan lewat pengeras suara Lena, setiap orang di setiap rumah di luar sana.

121.en: He hadn't told them it was deliberate. He hadn't told them about the stolen credentials, or the boundary drawn three weeks ago, or the tablet that had been switched on inside their own town. He hadn't told them PHASE ONE READY.
121.id: Ia belum memberi tahu mereka bahwa itu disengaja. Ia belum memberi tahu mereka soal kredensial yang dicuri, atau batas yang digambar tiga minggu lalu, atau tablet yang dinyalakan di dalam kota mereka sendiri. Ia belum memberi tahu mereka soal FASE SATU SIAP.

122.en: He hadn't decided whether he was going to.
122.id: Ia belum memutuskan apakah akan memberitahukannya.

123.en: Jack looked at Sarah. She looked back at him, and for once, she didn't have the next question ready.
123.id: Jack memandang Sarah. Sarah balas memandangnya, dan kali ini, ia tidak punya pertanyaan berikutnya yang sudah siap.

124.en: Nearly five hundred people were waiting for his answer.
124.id: Hampir lima ratus orang menunggu jawabannya.

125.en: And one of them, maybe, already knew it.
125.id: Dan salah satu dari mereka, mungkin, sudah tahu jawabannya.
